title: Solution Tree
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact (absorption wave 1; AIDE journal.py port). Output of tools/solution_tree.py for experiment-journaler / ablation-runner / tree_explore: experiment variants organized as a scored tree (node = variant artifact + parent + metric + buggy flag + draft/debug/improve action). The draft/debug/improve policy reads this tree to propose the NEXT bounded attempt. Node execution stays behind the director-supervised EXECUTE gate; until live GPU runs, metric comes from design-time auditor scores. best_node_id is DERIVED (highest non-buggy metric), never a self-award.

parent_id.description: null for root drafts; otherwise an existing node_id (enforced by solution_tree.py).

artifact_ref.description: The variant's artifact (experiment_matrix / patch_plan / run_record ref).

metric.description: Scored value (higher is better per the active profile metric); null = not yet scored.

buggy.description: true when the variant failed / is known-broken (debug targets).

best_node_id.description: DERIVED: node with the highest non-null metric among non-buggy nodes; null when nothing is scored yet.
